app.QnVzaW5lc3NDZW50cmFs.action.bWFrZS1h.source: Make a custom API call to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central
app.QnVzaW5lc3NDZW50cmFs.action.bWFrZS1h.message: Make a custom API call to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central

app.QnVzaW5lc3NDZW50cmFs.action.bWFrZS1h.source:
Make a custom HTTP / REST API call to **Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central** using the configured connection's authentication.

Specify the HTTP method, the URI path (relative to the connection's API base URL), optional query parameters, headers, and request body. The response is returned as a hash containing the status code, response headers, and response body.

Use this action for endpoints that are not yet exposed as first-class actions on this app.
app.QnVzaW5lc3NDZW50cmFs.action.bWFrZS1h.message:

Specify the HTTP method, the URI path (relative to the connection's API base URL), optional query parameters, headers, and request body. The response is returned as a hash containing the status code, response headers, and response body.

Use this action for endpoints that are not yet exposed as first-class actions on this app.

app.QnVzaW5lc3NDZW50cmFs.action.bWFrZS1h.message: Pass the body to the REST client unchanged; the client decides serialization based on its configured `data` option and the value type

app.QnVzaW5lc3NDZW50cmFs.action.bWFrZS1h.source: Serialize the body as JSON; sets `Content-Type: application/json`. The body should be a hash, list, or scalar value.
app.QnVzaW5lc3NDZW50cmFs.action.bWFrZS1h.message: Serialize the body as JSON; sets `Content-Type: application/json`. The body should be a hash, list, or scalar value.

app.QnVzaW5lc3NDZW50cmFs.action.bWFrZS1h.message: Serialize body as application/x-www-form-urlencoded form fields

app.QnVzaW5lc3NDZW50cmFs.action.bWFrZS1h.source: Serialize a hash of form fields as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`. The body must be a hash whose values are scalars (strings/numbers/booleans).
app.QnVzaW5lc3NDZW50cmFs.action.bWFrZS1h.message: Serialize a hash of form fields as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`. The body must be a hash whose values are scalars (strings/numbers/booleans).

app.QnVzaW5lc3NDZW50cmFs.action.bWFrZS1h.source: Upload a file using `multipart/form-data`. The body must be a @ref DataProvider::FileDataType "FileDataType" structure (filename + content + mime_type). The framework builds the multipart envelope and sets the boundary header.
app.QnVzaW5lc3NDZW50cmFs.action.bWFrZS1h.message: Upload a file using `multipart/form-data`. The body must be a @ref DataProvider::FileDataType "FileDataType" structure (filename + content + mime_type). The framework builds the multipart envelope and sets the boundary header.

app.QnVzaW5lc3NDZW50cmFs.action.bWFrZS1h.source: Send the body as XML. If the body is a hash it is serialized to XML; if it is a string it is sent verbatim. Sets `Content-Type: application/xml`.
app.QnVzaW5lc3NDZW50cmFs.action.bWFrZS1h.message: Send the body as XML. If the body is a hash it is serialized to XML; if it is a string it is sent verbatim. Sets `Content-Type: application/xml`.

app.QnVzaW5lc3NDZW50cmFs.action.bWFrZS1h.source: Send the body as YAML. If the body is a hash it is serialized to YAML; if it is a string it is sent verbatim. Sets `Content-Type: application/x-yaml`.
app.QnVzaW5lc3NDZW50cmFs.action.bWFrZS1h.message: Send the body as YAML. If the body is a hash it is serialized to YAML; if it is a string it is sent verbatim. Sets `Content-Type: application/x-yaml`.

app.QnVzaW5lc3NDZW50cmFs.action.bWFrZS1h.source: Send the body as plain text. The body must be a string. Sets `Content-Type: text/plain`.
app.QnVzaW5lc3NDZW50cmFs.action.bWFrZS1h.message: Send the body as plain text. The body must be a string. Sets `Content-Type: text/plain`.

app.QnVzaW5lc3NDZW50cmFs.action.bWFrZS1h.source: Send the body as raw bytes. The body must be a binary value. Sets `Content-Type: application/octet-stream` unless overridden by `hdr`.
app.QnVzaW5lc3NDZW50cmFs.action.bWFrZS1h.message: Send the body as raw bytes. The body must be a binary value. Sets `Content-Type: application/octet-stream` unless overridden by `hdr`.

app.QnVzaW5lc3NDZW50cmFs.action.bWFrZS1h.source: The request body. The effective type depends on `body_type`: JSON/form/YAML expect a hash, XML/text expect a string, multipart expects a file structure, binary expects raw bytes.
app.QnVzaW5lc3NDZW50cmFs.action.bWFrZS1h.message: The request body. The effective type depends on `body_type`: JSON/form/YAML expect a hash, XML/text expect a string, multipart expects a file structure, binary expects raw bytes.

app.QnVzaW5lc3NDZW50cmFs.action.bWFrZS1h.source: Hash of values substituted into `{name}` placeholders in the URI path. Example: with `path = /users/{id}` and `path_vars = {id: 123}` the framework sends `/users/123`. Values are URL-encoded.
app.QnVzaW5lc3NDZW50cmFs.action.bWFrZS1h.message: Hash of values substituted into `{name}` placeholders in the URI path. Example: with `path = /users/{id}` and `path_vars = {id: 123}` the framework sends `/users/123`. Values are URL-encoded.

app.QnVzaW5lc3NDZW50cmFs.action.bWFrZS1h.source: Hash of query string parameters to append to the URI path. Values are URL-encoded; list values are joined with `,`.
app.QnVzaW5lc3NDZW50cmFs.action.bWFrZS1h.message: Hash of query string parameters to append to the URI path. Values are URL-encoded; list values are joined with `,`.

app.QnVzaW5lc3NDZW50cmFs.action.bWFrZS1h.source: Hash of custom headers added to the request. These override any default headers set by `body_type` (e.g. supplying `Content-Type` here wins over the body-type default).
